learned_this_session: transactions.status is NULLABLE (schema.sql:274, VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'UNRECONCILED', no NOT NULL). Never write `status != 'VOID'` or `Not(TransactionStatus.VOID)` -- it silently drops NULL-status rows. Use the entity's isVoid getter in JS, or the reports' `(t.status IS NULL OR t.status != 'VOID')` in SQL.

Reuse an existing translated key across namespaces instead of adding an en-only one where the copy is identical (payees.service.ts:175 is the precedent). Locale parity then stays green and no localization pass is owed. A new en-only key in errors.json costs ~36 parity failures.

A nested withScopedDb JOINS the ambient transaction, so an assertXOwned helper that opens its own withScopedDb still runs inside the caller's transaction and refuses before the write. This is the RLS-era replacement for 'pass the QueryRunner manager down' -- review findings written against the old codebase will ask for a QueryRunner that no longer exists anywhere in src/.
Jest here is v30: the flag is --testPathPatterns (plural), not --testPathPattern.
createScopedDbMocks THROWS for an unregistered entity, so adding a repository read to a service means registering [Entity, mock] in its spec's createScopedDbMocks list.

Always verify a regression test fails without the fix by actually reverting the fix and re-running. Two of this session's tests (the null-clears cases) pass either way by design -- they pin the fix's boundary, not the defect -- and only the revert run distinguishes those from tests that are simply vacuous.
